svg.aria-label: The cost of a wing less the folded line minus 0.73 minus 0.65 times the folded angle, for the phase gap q from 1/2 to pi minus 1/2, symmetric about pi over 2: in blue for the least cost over the charts in the ceiling, dashed for the lower bounds of the proof, from the far vertex with the tangent of the square root up to 1 and from the cap between 1 and pi over 2; all are positive, the bounds of the proof by at least 0.004
